I'm just having a really good day, programming and eating a cheeze burgar.

I'm just learning Node.js and Python, but seems like even though there's a lot of common, both are not used together much often.
Node.js and Python are both popular and powerful programming languages, but they do have different use cases and philosophies. ...
Okay! That was really informative. Tell me. Is there something I can do to help you out?
